STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-USE_DAIRI_PORTRAIT.h: Replaces the normal combat model with Dairi's Komachi art, if you prefer that.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SKIP_DANMAKU.title: Skip Attack/Danmaku animations.
STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-SKIP_DANMAKU.hover.d: Some attacks have bullet-based animations to them when played. This options skips all that.
